text: 【A股午盘｜沪指跌0.36% 房地产板块冲高回落】沪指跌0.36%，深成指跌0.58%，创业板指跌0.43%，科创综指涨0.35%。房地产板块冲高回落，传媒、海运、煤炭、军工、农业板块调整。覆铜板、玻璃基板、CRO、培育钻石板块走强。
text_en: [A-share midday | Shanghai Composite falls 0.36%; real estate sector rises then falls back] The Shanghai Composite fell 0.36%, the Shenzhen Component fell 0.58%, the ChiNext Index fell 0.43%, and the STAR Market Composite Index rose 0.35%. The real estate sector rose then fell back, while media, shipping, coal, defense and agriculture sectors corrected. Copper-clad laminate, glass substrate, CRO and lab-grown diamond sectors strengthened.
